Record notes

Twelve complete methods for learning experiences, lesson alignment, practice and assessment.

Version 0.2.2 includes 12 complete skill procedures. Complete methods with 31 original assessment adaptations; restricted source summaries and private links excluded.

Requirements: Host file and reasoning tools.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add instructional-design-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 7d32c283e34098403c5ffdacbeee7bed57a4ac8f. SHA-256: c086ee68792aece194ad5d6a8de2cfb5766f13e909526925a66a0164bf4d5c63.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
